summary: Iteration 9 (frontend-only). Verified Aventura → Enduro hub + 4n/5d + 6n/7d program pages (ES/EN/FR) and three VideoSection blocks on /viajes/surdemarruecos. All testids resolve, breadcrumbs are correct in 3 languages, peer-nav and hub links navigate correctly, Aventura CTA + enduro experience card route to /viajes/aventura/enduro, and the Sur videos render with play/mute controls in correct vertical order. Mute toggle confirmed functional (True→False). Play toggle does not flip paused because Pexels CDN URLs return 403 — accepted per the iteration's agent-to-agent note (validate DOM + controls, not actual playback). Only console errors are the 403 from Pexels video CDN.

issues: Pexels CDN URLs return 403 — videos never load; only the poster/shimmer is visible. Functionally controls are wired but real playback never starts. Consider hosting videos on a reliable CDN or use a working sample, otherwise the cinematic intent is lost in production.

action_items: Replace the Pexels video URLs in /app/frontend/src/pages/SurPage.jsx SUR_VIDEOS dict with self-hosted or working sources (current sources return HTTP 403).
critical_code_review_comments: VideoSection: setLoaded only fires onLoadedData; since Pexels URLs 403 the shimmer overlay remains forever. Consider adding onError to also clear/replace the shimmer with the poster.

The wrapper testid `aventura-enduro-cta` is on a <section>; the request's spec says it should be 'clickable' (the clickable element is correctly `aventura-enduro-cta-link`). Minor naming clarity, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Enduro hub + program wiring is functional. Sur video section's only known limitation is the Pexels CDN 403 — DOM/controls verified, so iteration 8's peer-nav system continues to PASS. On mobile (390x844) the inner container resolves to `aspect-[16/9] md:aspect-[21/9]` correctly. No regression detected on /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d-style routes (Aventura page still renders 9.9k chars of body text).
rca of the issue: No bug to RCA. The play-toggle 'no-change' observation is a side-effect of Pexels 403 — videoRef.current.play() is wrapped in .catch(()=>{}) so state silently remains paused. Expected per testing note.
